title: Store accounts to publish from
summary: Settle which Google Play and Apple developer accounts the app will be published from.
why: If you have more than one account (personal/company), creating or publishing an app in the wrong one cannot be undone; the package name gets locked to that account. Claude performs **no store action** until this record is processed, and before every action it verifies that the active account matches it.
prerequisites: Google Play Console developer account (one-time 25 USD) and a paid Apple Developer Program membership (99 USD per year).

steps.title: Open Play Console and select the account to publish from
steps.detail: If you have more than one Google account, switch to the right one at the top right; if you have more than one developer account, pick the right one from the account selector at the top left.

steps.title: Copy the developer account ID
steps.detail: The long number in `play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/**<ID>**/…` in the address bar. Also take the developer name from **Settings → Developer account → Account details**.

steps.title: Select the right team in your Apple Developer account
steps.detail: If you have more than one team, switch to the right one from the name menu at the top right.

steps.title: Copy the team name and Team ID
steps.detail: The *Membership details* card shows the **Team Name** and **Team ID** (10 characters).

warnings: Do not act in the wrong account: this record is the reference for verification in all later store actions (RULES.md Section 12.8).

fields.label: Play developer account ID
fields.patternHint: The number after developers/ in the address bar.

fields.label: These two accounts are the **correct** ones to publish the app from
